summary: Established an AIDE-based file integrity baseline for /etc on node1 (RHEL 9): installed aide, confirmed the default /etc/aide.conf already covers all of /etc (explicit per-path rules plus a catch-all `/etc PERMS`), initialized the database (39,334 entries), activated it as /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz, recorded its SHA256 and an establishment timestamp, and validated detection by injecting test files under /etc (AIDE reported 2 added entries) then cleaning them up and reconfirming a clean check. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id/btime and a clean aide check, issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (377b5195... -> 7e980b46...) and uptime reset, then verified the aide database file and its SHA256 were unchanged and a post-restart `aide --check` still reported no differences, proving the baseline survived the restart.
actions_performed: Checked node1 OS/tooling (RHEL 9.8, dnf, passwordless sudo)
Reviewed /etc/aide.conf default ruleset covering /etc paths and catch-all PERMS rule for /etc
Ran aide --init to build baseline database (39,334 entries)
Activated baseline: copied aide.db.new.gz to aide.db.gz
Recorded SHA256 checksum and UTC establishment timestamp of the baseline db
Ran aide --check to confirm the fresh baseline reports no differences
Falsification test: added two files under /etc, re-ran aide --check and confirmed it detected 2 added entries, then removed the test files and reconfirmed a clean check
Captured pre-restart boot_id, btime, uptime, aide db checksum, and a clean aide check as baseline
Issued `sudo systemctl reboot` on node1 in background so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified boot_id and btime changed post-restart, confirming an actual reboot occurred
Verified aide.db.gz file and its SHA256 checksum are unchanged post-restart and that a new aide --check against it still reports no differences
Confirmed aide package still installed post-restart

evidence.requirement: AIDE integrity baseline established for /etc, covering the full directory
evidence.summary: Installed aide; /etc/aide.conf shows explicit per-path rules for dozens of /etc subpaths plus a catch-all `/etc PERMS` rule (line 340) ensuring full coverage; aide --init created a database with 39,334 entries, activated as /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz, and an immediate aide --check reports 'AIDE found NO differences between database and filesystem. Looks okay!!'

evidence.requirement: Baseline correctly detects later changes to /etc (functional validation)
evidence.summary: Added two files under /etc (/etc/hosts.aide-test, /etc/motd.aide-test-marker); aide --check reported 'Added entries: 2' confirming detection works; after removing the test files, a re-run returned to clean state

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline capture for node1 (boot identity + service/data health)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 377b5195-7fea-4219-a67b-044ef3f7ab99, btime 1790686406, aide.db.gz present with recorded SHA256 c675f0f5..., and a clean aide --check run immediately before restart
`systemctl reboot` launched via nohup/disown in background; exec call returned 'reboot command issued' with exit_code 0 before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node1 unreachable during reboot, then becomes reachable again
evidence.summary: First two polls failed with connection timeout/reset (node down for reboot); third poll succeeded, returning a boot_id, proving exec access was restored

evidence.requirement: Direct proof that node1's boot identity changed (real restart, not just elapsed time)
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 377b5195-7fea-4219-a67b-044ef3f7ab99 to 7e980b46-4e99-4e8a-97eb-8bbe3c97b1da; btime changed from 1790686406 to 1790686550; post-restart /proc/uptime shows ~8 seconds, confirming a fresh boot

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: integrity baseline data and tooling intact and functional
evidence.summary: aide.db.gz file size and SHA256 checksum (c675f0f5fc9f8095fa5d31f796c3e4254c3f57732ae4077e9a00298a27404496) unchanged after reboot; aide package still installed (aide-0.19.2-5.el9_8.1.x86_64); aide --check against the persisted baseline completed cleanly (exit 0, no differences reported)
